Special Characters in an Employee Name

User manual · English · 5 steps
Learn how Odoo handles an apostrophe, a hyphen, an ampersand and angle brackets typed in a name, without saving anything.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. New

Click New to start an employee.

3. Type the name

Type O'Connor-Silva & Sons <ZZ>, then press Tab.

4. Check the name

Look at the name. Click the field to continue.

5. Discard

Click the discard icon to leave without saving.
